# Reza Nobakht

> CTO and backend engineer based in Shiraz, Iran. Runs engineering for a cross-border payments platform built on Laravel/PHP. Puts LLM features into production: tool-calling agents, AI ticket triage, LLM-as-judge evals. Open to remote backend / AI engineering roles.

- Name: Reza Nobakht (Persian: رضا نوبخت)
- Role: CTO, backend & AI engineer
- Core stack: Laravel, PHP 8.3, MySQL/InnoDB, Redis, Cloudflare, CI/CD
- Track record: upgraded a live payment platform from Laravel 5.6 to 13 (PHP 7.1 to 8.3) with zero downtime; raised uptime from 96% to 99%; leads a team of 6 engineers; 8+ years of production Laravel/PHP.
